spec.hypothesis: taker_imbalance FAILED well-powered on majors (sprint20/22) and liquid-8-alts (sprint13/21/23), both directions. qhour_open's identical majors->alts->tail-liquidity progression (sprint09->16->34) established this design pattern. Liu-Tsyvinski et al (cited sprint18/26/32/34) predicts order-flow effects concentrate in smaller, less-liquid, higher-turnover names. Last untested cell in the 5-signal x 3-universe matrix.
spec.power_argument: sprint34 (same basket, qhour_open) validation: n=1616, t=-18.392, mean_net=-36.427bps -> back-solved sigma ~= 36.427*sqrt(1616)/18.392 ~= 79.6bps. At n=300, 80% power, two-sided 5%: min detectable edge = 2.8*79.6/sqrt(300) ~= 12.9bps, below T2 cost floor (~26bp). sprint34 realized 1616 validation trades under identical caps/basket, so n>=300 is near-certain.
